keen.attack_fit_limitations: About a dozen cycles and one AR setting. Exponential-in-attenuation form is assumed; source may contain analog and dynamic processing. Repeated fits are descriptive, not recovered rate constants.
keen.onset_finding: The D2R20 note reaches approximately the same -7.1dBFS peak as neighboring flat notes, then starts its slow decay. No missing initial18dB drop was found in direct positive waveform peaks.
unavailable_controls: No clean static carrier-TL sweep with otherwise identical patch and known gains was established.

No second nonzero D2R or RR value was recovered in an equally isolated, unchanged pure-carrier setting. The display593s case has D1R63/D2R63 and demonstrates only a very short event. Other RR changes have nonzero modulation/feedback/RKS and are unsuitable numeric controls.
keen.cutoff: Coherent sine becomes abruptly absent near48dB below its -7.1dBFS plateau in the known RR8 examples. Chip endpoint, editor/global effects, upstream gate and codec behavior remain unresolved; no cutoff constant is inferred.

independent_joint_estimator.method: Separate left/right/arithmetic mid; simultaneous sine/cosine least squares plus DC at fixed equal-tempered MIDI pitches 39,46,58,59,67,75,79,87; Hann taper applied to both basis and signal (squared-Hann objective); 2ms hop; no local frequency, time, or gain fit

exact780.gain_only_test: During70–100ms after inferred off the already-held MIDI58 remains flat while MIDI75 falls about233dB/s. During140–200ms the held partial remains flat while the released75 tail flattens near20dB below its plateau. A large common gain rise alone would also lift the held partial. Conditional on constant held-source amplitude and separable partials, common postmix static compression/AGC cannot by itself explain either feature. This does not exclude internal envelope shaping, external reverberation, per-band/per-voice processing, or arbitrary compensating gain upstream.
exact780.independent_vs_holdout: Estimator independence only. This is the same recording already used for calibration and root final-chord analysis.

MIDI87 maycontainMIDI75secondharmonic; MIDI39 lowfrequency estimator has fewcycles in20ms.

extended_endpoint.estimator_limitation: 35 of36 channel/taper/pitch combinations satisfy the persistent-departure detector. Right-channel20ms MIDI39 does not; its short low-frequency window and weak channel prevent this threshold claim. All12 arithmetic-mid combinations satisfy it. Missing departure fields mean not found, not a zero-time event.

exact780.extended_endpoint_conclusion: Four mid-channel coherent partials disappear at separate times, before source end, after earlier late slopes. The recorded arithmetic-mid amplitude50ms before the descriptive departures clusters near-61dBFS, but this is not a calibrated hardware attenuation: channel phase/chorus and recording gain matter. Individual channel departures differ, especially for weak/cancelling channels. Raw carrier LKS0xB9 is nonzero, so an intrinsic total-attenuation endpoint would not imply equal EG attenuation or equal time. No fixed EG cutoff is recovered.

conclusions.finding: The ~230dB/s fast release is repeatable across two independent estimators and two separate known-RR8 recordings (480 and780).
conclusions.confidence: high for recorded waveform; conditional for raw RR identity in video480; not proof of a complete hardware timing law
